purpose: Reproduce P8 planning, real local CaseVO orchestration, and the exact corrected ZIP under CPython 3.9
conclusion: Covered Python 3.9 cases activate P8 and match Python 3.12 decisions; no general Python 3.9 or NetworkX 3.1 silent fallback was reproduced.
limitations: The evaluator's hidden seeds and exact CaseVO installation are unavailable.
The successful CaseVO runs used the clean local CaseVO 0.3.19 checkout and typing_extensions 4.16.0.
Pinning typing_extensions 4.5.0 with the otherwise declared packages makes the current public resolver select a ChromaDB/Pydantic combination that fails before the P8 controller is constructed.
